summary: myidsan gains the first-run operator experience mymatasan/myseliasan already have (PR A of the wizard+packaging plan; packaging is a later PR B). app/firstrun.go (ported from apps/myseliasan/app/firstrun.go) prints a console banner ("MyIDSan is ready") and writes an INITIAL_ADMIN_LOGIN.txt recovery file (0600, data dir) whenever the bootstrap superadmin is freshly seeded; a RESET_ADMIN one-shot marker file in the data dir is the lock-out recovery path, deleted BEFORE the reset runs so a crash can't re-run it, then force-resets the password/reactivates the account/re-pins the superadmin role via the new services.ResetStockSuperadmin. services/user_login.go's EnsureStockSuperadmin now returns a StockSeedResult{Username,Password,Generated,Seeded} and, when config/env both leave localAuth.password empty, GENERATES a per-install 16-character password (crypto/rand, unambiguous charset) instead of falling back to a hard-coded default - the generated password is never rotated on later boots (only a config/env-supplied one still refreshes in, and only while the account is untouched). A new setup wizard (services/setup_state.go + apis/setup.go, mirroring mymatasan's setup-state contract; persisted in the new shared RuntimeSetting entity under key "setup.state") walks a superadmin through 5 steps - Welcome, register the first relying app (app-registry + auth-config + redirect-uri, secret generated if left blank and shown once), optional LDAP quick-enable, create a personal superadmin account (via the new POST /api/user-credential admin-provisioning endpoint, distinct from self-registration which lands pending), and Done - shown only after the forced password change clears and only until GET /api/setup/state reports completed; every step is skippable and POST /api/setup/complete (or Skip setup) records completion once, shared across browsers.
compatibility: Backward compatible for existing installs: config.json ships a non-empty localAuth.password (admin/admin123), so EnsureStockSuperadmin keeps refreshing that config password exactly as before and never generates one - the new codepath only activates when localAuth.password AND LOCAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD are both empty (e.g. a fresh config.dev.json boot). An existing account that already cleared its forced password change is untouched and is never asked to redo it. The setup wizard only appears for the superadmin and only until GET /api/setup/state reports completed=true; on upgrade an existing install's setup.state row is absent, so the wizard will appear once for existing superadmins until they finish or skip it - a one-time, skippable prompt, no forced action, no schema change beyond the additive RuntimeSetting table already used by other apps. RESET_ADMIN requires local filesystem access to the data dir and is opt-in (never triggered unless an operator or installer drops the marker). Verified live on a fresh sqlite boot: banner + recovery file written (config password path points at config; generated-password path echoes the password); unauthenticated GET /api/setup/state -> 401; state false after login; complete blocked until the forced password change clears, then completes and persists; RESET_ADMIN marker consumed and deleted on reboot, old password rejected, config password restored with must-change re-flagged.
